name: Safety Permissive Interlock Chain
description: All process outputs gated through a single permissive BOOL. All safety conditions ANDed into one variable for easy monitoring.
safety_notes: Single All_OK variable gates everything — easy to add new conditions without changing output logic. Any FALSE in the AND chain de-energizes all outputs.
common_mistakes: Gating outputs individually instead of through single permissive — easy to miss one
Not including Fault_State in permissive chain
